item.title: Kevin Kaukuarjuk Qamaniq-Mason
item.description: Kevin Kaukuarjuk Qamaniq-Mason grew up in Iglulik and spent his teenage years in Iqaluit. His mother, Asita Uvinik Qamaniq, is from Iglurjuat, and his father, Marcel Mason, was from New Brunswick. item.title: Anchorage Daily News Reviews Leave Our Bones Where They Lay
item.description: Anchorage Daily News has reviewed Leave Our Bones Where They Lay, written by Aviaq Johnston. “This book explores the importance of storytelling, and the necessity of passing those stories down to the next generation. It’s steeped in Inuit culture, but its message is universal.” Read the whole article HERE!
